    data=df,
    x="megapixels",
    y="price_usd",
    hue="sensor_type",
    size="max_iso",
    sizes=(400, 4000),  # Control the min and max size of the bubbles
    palette="plasma",
    alpha=0.8,
    edgecolor="black",

)

# Use a tight layout to ensure all elements fit, then save the figure
